summary.headline: Update Ring report navigation follows the Windows updates workspace
summary.summary: Report access now starts at Devices > Windows, then Manage updates > Windows updates, before selecting Update rings.
summary.adminImpact: Use the Windows updates workspace path when opening an Update Ring policy report.

summary.headline: Update Ring policy guidance adopts its current product name
summary.summary: The article title is now Windows Update rings policy and its description covers creating and managing update ring policies; Intune Plan 1 is linked as the core requirement.
summary.adminImpact: Confirm Intune Plan 1 licensing before creating or assigning update ring policies.

summary.headline: Tier1 for Intune is listed as a supported partner app
summary.summary: Tier1 for Intune provides mobile customer relationship management, including client details, interaction history, opportunities, call reports, tasks, meetings, and files through Intune-protected access.
summary.adminImpact: Review the iOS app and applicable Intune app protection policy before making it available to users.

summary.headline: Clarity Express for Intune is listed as a supported partner app
summary.summary: Clarity Express for Intune provides Android and iOS access to work items, progress tracking, and Clarity data while using Intune app protection policies.
summary.adminImpact: Evaluate the Android and iOS app variants and assign the required app protection policies before deployment.

summary.headline: Configuration Manager AdminService rejects NTLM authentication
summary.summary: Configuration Manager version 2509 guidance announces that AdminService rejects NTLM authentication.
summary.adminImpact: Identify AdminService clients that use NTLM and move them to a supported authentication method before upgrading.
